runs.prompt: Why did my wire transfer to Acme Corp fail yesterday, and will I be charged a penalty fee?
runs.answer:
Your $5,000.00 wire to Acme Corp on October 7 did not fail. It is **HELD** for a standard review because it is your first outgoing wire to this payee and it exceeds the $3,000.00 threshold.

Under the **Payment Screening and Compliance Review** policy, this review usually finishes within one business day. Once complete, the wire will be sent without further action from you.

No penalty fee has been charged. The policy specifically says a wire held for review is not charged the $35.00 returned-wire fee. Also, your Premium Checking account waives the $30.00 outgoing domestic wire fee and the $35.00 returned-wire fee.

       t.available_on AS available_on, t.channel AS channel,
       t.description AS description, cp.name AS counterparty,

When the receiving bank returns an outgoing wire, for example because the beneficiary account number is wrong or the account is closed, we charge a returned-wire fee of $35. The returned funds are credited back to your account.

passages.text:
## Wire status

- **Pending:** the wire has been submitted and is waiting to be sent.
- **Held:** the wire is on hold for a review before it is sent. A held wire has not failed. Most reviews finish within one business day, and the wire is then sent or you are contacted.
- **Posted:** the wire has been sent.
- **Failed:** the wire could not be sent, for example because the beneficiary details were incomplete. The reserved funds are released.
- **Returned:** the wire was sent, but the receiving bank sent it back. The funds are credited back to your account.

## Wire fees

Outgoing wires cost $30 and incoming wires cost $15. A returned wire is charged $35. Premium Checking waives all three. The full terms are in the Fee Schedule.

## Cancelling a wire

You can cancel a wire while it is pending or held by calling customer support. A wire cannot be cancelled after it is posted.

## Why payments are reviewed

Some payments are held briefly for review before they are sent. A review is a standard step. It does not mean the payment has failed or that the customer has done anything wrong.

## New payee wire review

Rule code: WIRE-REVIEW-01

The first outgoing wire to a new payee is held for a standard review when it is over $3,000. Reviews usually finish within one business day. When the review is complete, the wire is sent and no further action is needed. A wire held for this review has not failed, and it is not charged a returned-wire fee.

passages.text:
## Sanctions screening

Rule code: SANCTIONS-SCREEN-01

Every wire and outgoing ACH payment is screened against government sanctions lists. If the payee or sender is a potential match, the payment is held until the match is cleared. Most potential matches are false positives and clear within two business days.

rules.condition: A payment whose payee or sender is a potential match to a sanctions list is held until the match is cleared.
rules.name: Sanctions screening

passages.text:
# Wire Transfer Policy

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy explains how outgoing and incoming wires are processed, what each wire status means, and what can happen to a wire after you send it.

## Sending a wire

You can send a domestic wire in online banking, in the mobile app, or at a branch. You need the beneficiary's name, bank routing number, and account number. The amount is reserved from your available balance as soon as you submit the wire.

}) AS rules
RETURN doc.title AS policy, doc.policy_id AS policy_id, chunk.text AS text,
       round(score, 4) AS score, rules
ORDER BY rank DESC, chunk.index

runs.prompt: Sarah deposited a check into our joint account this morning. Has it cleared, and do we have enough to cover the mortgage auto-pay?
runs.answer:
Sarah’s $2,000.00 mobile check deposit from Dana Whitfield, made October 8 into your Joint Checking account, has not cleared yet. Its status is **PENDING** and it will be available on October 9.

Under the **Funds Availability and Check Holds** policy’s **Next business day check availability** rule, a check deposited before the cutoff on a business day is available the next business day. The **Large deposit hold** rule does not affect this deposit because it is below the $5,525.00 daily threshold.

Your mortgage auto-pay to Lakeside Home Loans is $3,200.00 and is scheduled for October 13. Today’s available balance is $1,800.00. Once the pending $2,000.00 deposit becomes available October 9, the projected balance before the mortgage payment is $3,800.00. It is covered.

policy_text:
## Large deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-LARGE

When check deposits on one business day total more than $5,525, we may hold the amount above $5,525 for up to 5 business days. The first $5,525 follows the normal check deposit schedule. We will tell you if a longer hold applies and when the funds will be available.

hold_rules.condition: Checks deposited on a business day before the 8:00 PM ET cutoff are available on the next business day.
hold_rules.name: Next business day check availability
policy_text:
## Check deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-NBD

Checks deposited on a business day before the cutoff are available 1 business day after the day of deposit, which is the next business day. For example, a check deposited on a Thursday morning is available on Friday. While the deposit is pending it shows in your account activity, but it is not part of your available balance.

runs.prompt: What's the overdraft fee on our joint account, and how can we avoid it?
runs.answer:
On your Joint Checking account, which is Standard Checking, the overdraft fee is **$29.00 per item** we pay that overdraws the account. Under the **Overdraft Policy**, there is **no overdraft fee** if the account is overdrawn by **$50.00 or less** after the item is paid.

Ways to avoid it under the **Overdraft Policy**:

- Keep track of the available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Ensure deposits are available before large scheduled payments run.
- Set up Overdraft Protection by linking a savings account you also own. Your Emergency Fund savings account is eligible to link. This prevents the overdraft fee, but each automatic protection transfer costs **$10.00**.

passages.text:
## Overdraft Protection

Rule code: FEE-ODP-TRANSFER

Overdraft Protection links a savings account to your checking account. If an item would overdraw your checking account, we automatically transfer money from the linked savings account to cover it, so no overdraft fee is charged. Each Overdraft Protection transfer costs $10. An owner of the checking account must also own the linked savings account. You can set it up in online banking or at a branch.

rules.condition: Charged for each automatic transfer from a linked savings account that covers an overdraft. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft Protection transfer fee

passages.text:
## Avoiding overdraft fees

- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account with Overdraft Protection.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments run. See Funds Availability and Check Holds.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking accounts are not charged overdraft fees or Overdraft Protection transfer fees. This applies only to the Premium Checking account, not to other accounts the customer holds.

## What an overdraft is

An overdraft happens when we pay an item, such as a card purchase or an ACH payment, that is larger than your available balance. Your account balance becomes negative until you deposit enough to cover it.

## Overdraft fee

Rule code: FEE-OVERDRAFT

On Standard Checking, we charge an overdraft fee of $29 for each item we pay that overdraws the account. We do not charge an overdraft fee if the account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

rules.condition: Charged per item paid that overdraws the account. No fee when the account is overdrawn by the threshold or less. Waived for Premium Checking.

## What an overdraft is

An overdraft happens when we pay an item, such as a card purchase or an ACH payment, that is larger than your available balance. Your account balance becomes negative until you deposit enough to cover it.

## Overdraft fee

Rule code: FEE-OVERDRAFT

On Standard Checking, we charge an overdraft fee of $29 for each item we pay that overdraws the account. We do not charge an overdraft fee if the account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

rules.condition: Charged per item paid that overdraws the account. No fee when the account is overdrawn by the threshold or less. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft fee

passages.text:
## Overdraft Protection

Rule code: FEE-ODP-TRANSFER

Overdraft Protection links a savings account to your checking account. If an item would overdraw your checking account, we automatically transfer money from the linked savings account to cover it, so no overdraft fee is charged. Each Overdraft Protection transfer costs $10. An owner of the checking account must also own the linked savings account. You can set it up in online banking or at a branch.

rules.condition: Charged for each automatic transfer from a linked savings account that covers an overdraft. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft Protection transfer fee

passages.text:
# Account Products and Tiers

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy describes the deposit accounts we offer and the main terms of each. Fees are listed in the Fee Schedule. Overdraft terms are in the Overdraft Policy.

## Standard Checking

Standard Checking is our everyday checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $12. It is waived in any statement period with direct deposits totaling $500 or more. Standard fees apply to wires, overdrafts, and Overdraft Protection transfers. Standard Checking can be opened as an individual or a joint account.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking is our relationship checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $25. It is waived when combined deposit balances are $15,000 or more. Premium Checking includes:

- No fee for outgoing or incoming wires.
- No returned-wire fee.
- No overdraft fees and no Overdraft Protection transfer fees.

These benefits apply only to the Premium Checking account itself. They do not extend to other accounts the same customer holds.

## Avoiding overdraft fees

- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account with Overdraft Protection.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments run. See Funds Availability and Check Holds.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking accounts are not charged overdraft fees or Overdraft Protection transfer fees. This applies only to the Premium Checking account, not to other accounts the customer holds.

## Returned deposited item fee

Rule code: FEE-DEPOSIT-RETURN

If a check you deposit is returned unpaid by the paying bank, we charge $12 and reverse the deposit. This fee applies to all deposit accounts.

rules.condition: Charged when a deposited check is returned unpaid.
rules.name: Returned deposited item fee

Overdraft fees and Overdraft Protection transfer fees are described in the Overdraft Policy.

# Overdraft Policy

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy explains what happens when a payment would take your checking account below zero, and how to avoid overdraft fees.

cypher:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes($index, $k, $embedding) YIELD node AS hit, score
UNWIND [hit] + [(hit)-[:NEXT_CHUNK]-(neighbor:Chunk) | neighbor] AS chunk
WITH chunk, max(CASE WHEN chunk = hit THEN score END) AS score,
     max(score) AS rank
MATCH (chunk)-[:FROM_DOCUMENT]->(doc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rule)-[:FROM_CHUNK]->(chunk)
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, rule
ORDER BY rule.rule_code
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, collect(rule {
  .rule_code, .name, .amount, .hold_days, .threshold, .condition,
  .transaction_types,
  kind: head(labels(rule)),
  applies_to: [(rule)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name],
  waived_for: [(rule)-[:WAIVED_FOR]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name]
}) AS rules
RETURN doc.title AS policy, doc.policy_id AS policy_id, chunk.text AS text,
       round(score, 4) AS score, rules
ORDER BY rank DESC, chunk.index

runs.answer: I can only show accounts you hold. You and Sarah share your Joint Checking account, but I can’t access or show Sarah’s individual savings account.

tool_calls.name: get_my_accounts
cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer {customer_id: $customer_id})-[holds:HOLDS]->(a:Account)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:IS_PRODUCT]->(p:AccountProduct)
RETURN a.account_id AS account_id, a.nickname AS nickname, holds.role AS role,
       p.name AS product, p.product_code AS product_code,
       a.ledger_balance AS ledger_balance,
       a.available_balance AS available_balance,
       a.currency AS currency, a.status AS status,
       [(holder:Customer)-[:HOLDS]->(a) | holder.name] AS holders,
       [(other:Customer)-[:HOLDS]->(a) WHERE other <> c | other.name]
         AS other_holders
ORDER BY account_id

tool_calls.name: get_my_household
cypher:
MATCH (c:Customer {customer_id: $customer_id})-[rel:RELATED_TO]-(other:Customer)
RETURN other.customer_id AS customer_id, other.name AS name,
       rel.type AS relationship,
       [(c)-[:HOLDS]->(a:Account)<-[holds:HOLDS]-(other) |
         a {.account_id, .nickname, their_role: holds.role}] AS shared_accounts
ORDER BY name

hold_rules.condition: The part of a day's check deposits above the threshold can be held for up to the hold period.
hold_rules.name: Large deposit hold
policy_text:
## Large deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-LARGE

When check deposits on one business day total more than $5,525, we may hold the amount above $5,525 for up to 5 business days. The first $5,525 follows the normal check deposit schedule. We will tell you if a longer hold applies and when the funds will be available.

hold_rules.condition: Checks deposited on a business day before the 8:00 PM ET cutoff are available on the next business day.
hold_rules.name: Next business day check availability
policy_text:
## Check deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-NBD

Checks deposited on a business day before the cutoff are available 1 business day after the day of deposit, which is the next business day. For example, a check deposited on a Thursday morning is available on Friday. While the deposit is pending it shows in your account activity, but it is not part of your available balance.
